Broad chest armor and shoulder guards frame the masked figure. Brick outlines, irregular paving, and the sword's wrapped grip supply smaller details around the fortress scene.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Underworld Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja appears above an Underworld scene in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a large masked portrait overlooking jagged caves and three skeleton minifigures below. A tall forehead crest and round uniform fastenings define the main character. Rib outlines, skull faces, and uneven rock arches create a denser foreground.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Monastery of Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja visits the Monastery of Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword beside a patterned doorway beneath a curved tiled roof. A small shaped tree stands near the stone path. The single shoulder guard, wrap-front uniform, chest emblem, and knotted sash keep the minifigure central within the architectural scene.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Temple of Dragon Cores Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands inside the Temple of Dragon Cores in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a broad sword across the foreground before dragon-decorated walls. Gem-shaped forms sit on small pedestals beside an arched doorway and patterned columns. The figure's shoulder armor, forehead emblem, and dragon chest motif add further detail.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Toxic Bogs Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja explores the Toxic Bogs in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, carrying a sword among cattails, bubbling pools, lily pads, rocks, and bare twisted branches. A small emblem fastens straps across the uniform. Knee panels, shoulder guards, the folded mask, and a knotted sash contrast with the swamp's irregular outlines.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Temple of Resurrection Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja holds a sword in the Temple of Resurrection in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing before a candlelit altar beneath a skull-marked arch. Tall decorated columns flank the scene inside a simple border. Cracked floor slabs, angular chest armor, shoulder guards, and a dragon emblem provide smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Jamanakai Village Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja visits Jamanakai Village in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword across the foreground beneath a folded hood and focused eyes above the mask. Curved-roof houses, a small gateway, and flowering branches frame the stone path. A large dragon chest motif and decorative fastenings distinguish the uniform.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Samurai X Cave Coloring Page
pages.description: Samurai armor fills this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page set in Samurai X Cave, with a sword raised beside a crested helmet and an X-marked breastplate. A small robot, large wrench, and equipment sit against rough cave walls. Layered shoulder pieces, belt pouches, knee panels, and the slotted face covering create mechanical costume details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Corridor of Elders Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja stands beneath a broad stone arch in the Corridor of Elders in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, facing forward with lowered hands. Carved faces decorate the pillars on either side, while dragon emblems on the headband and chest echo the warrior's detailed shoulder armor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Ice Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: A sword-bearing ninja stands inside the Ice Temple in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, surrounded by pointed crystals and an arch edged with icicles. The long blade crosses the figure's legs diagonally, and the symmetrical doorway behind the masked warrior has a small geometric window at its center.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Tournament Temple City Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked warrior holds a sword before the buildings of Tournament Temple City in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing on a raised stone platform. Hanging lanterns flank the temple entrance, with modern towers on one side of the skyline and a mountain rising on the other.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Temple of Light Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja raises a long sword inside the Temple of Light in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing between two columns beneath a pointed arch. Dragon designs run down both pillars, and a large circular dragon emblem hangs above the warrior's head over the tiled floor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Borg Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands inside Borg Tower in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with broad windows revealing the city skyline and a small airship outside. A large letter B appears above the masked figure, whose dragon-patterned uniform and shoulder armor contrast with the tower's curved architectural lines.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Kingdom of Shintaro Coloring Page
pages.description: A sword stretches across the foreground of this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, where a warrior stands against the mountain scenery of the Kingdom of Shintaro. Swept hair rises above the face covering, while a long stairway leads toward a tiered palace among narrow peaks and small flags.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Never Realm Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja faces forward among jagged ice formations in the Never Realm in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with snowflakes scattered across the open sky. Crystal-like shapes decorate the shoulder armor and sleeves, and a bare tree stands behind the figure's swept hair and layered face covering.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters on Island of the Keepers Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja holds an upright, flame-edged sword on the Island of the Keepers in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, surrounded by jungle foliage. Hanging vines frame the upper corners, while wall torches and broken stonework add smaller details around the warrior's full-length figure and patterned armor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Dragon Stone Shrine Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands beneath a rounded arch at the Dragon Stone Shrine in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sheathed sword at one side. A large horned dragon curves behind the figure, and smaller dragon designs decorate the columns beside the shrine's uneven stone paving.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in City Marketplace Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja stands in the City Marketplace in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a wrapped sword handle rising beside one lowered hand. Vases, a barrel, folded goods, and hanging lanterns line the street, while two smaller figures appear between the shops behind the central warrior.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Chen's Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja holds a short sword beneath the grand doorway of Chen's Palace in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with spiked hair above a headband. Lanterns hang from the columns on both sides, and a long banner descends into the curved arch above the warrior's uncovered face.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Merlopian Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked warrior stands among the underwater arches of the Merlopian Palace in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, facing forward with both hands lowered. Fin-shaped details extend from the helmet and arms, while bubbles, coral, and waving plants surround the palace walls behind the figure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Cloud Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja appears above a bank of clouds in the Cloud Kingdom in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing broad armor with dragon-decorated shoulder plates. Small temple rooftops and a gateway rise through the clouds behind the figure, leaving open space above the close view of the masked face.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters on Dark Island Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja raises one bent arm against the rocky landscape of Dark Island in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a determined gaze above the mask. Pointed peaks, sparse bamboo, and a bare branch frame the figure, whose chest strap, waist knot, and layered shoulders provide additional costume details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Glacier Barrens Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja holds a pointed throwing star in the Glacier Barrens in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing on a cracked icy surface. Snowflakes fall above the armored figure, with angular rock formations and an ice-covered gateway appearing behind the warrior's shoulder plates and dragon chest emblem.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Imperium City Coloring Page
pages.description: A close view of a masked warrior fills this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page set in Imperium City, where narrow futuristic towers rise on both sides. A high hair bun extends above the head covering, and small screens, antennae, and building panels add geometric details around the figure's broad shoulder armor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Shintaro Dungeons Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja grips a large rectangular hammer in the Shintaro Dungeons in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing among rough stone walls and scattered rocks. A burning wall torch, barred opening, and skull motif frame the scene, while straps cross the warrior's uniform beneath a round skull badge.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Source Henge Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands on a cracked platform at Source Henge in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword angled down toward the lower corner. Weathered columns decorated with flames flank the figure, and a larger dragon-marked stone rises above the rectangular gateway directly behind the warrior.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Ignacia Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja fills the foreground of this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page set in Ignacia, with two weapons rising behind the shoulders and curling flames nearby. A dragon design covers one side of the uniform, while a distant roofline and mountain peaks provide smaller background details.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in City Gardens Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands on a stepping-stone path in the City Gardens in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sheathed sword and buckled chest strap. A bonsai tree, bamboo stems, and a small garden lantern surround the figure, while a curved roof and ornamental gateway appear behind.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Royal Blacksmith Shop Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja holds a hammer and tongs inside the Royal Blacksmith Shop in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with spiked hair above a face covering. An anvil stands to one side and a flaming forge to the other, while additional tools and a sword hang on the brick wall.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters on Chen's Island Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja holds an upright patterned sword on Chen's Island in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with dragon designs covering the uniform and legs. A winding path crosses the rocky island below the figure, leading toward a tall tiered building between small palm trees.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Caves of Despair Coloring Page
pages.description: A sword-bearing ninja stands inside the Caves of Despair in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, framed by an uneven tunnel and long hanging rock formations. The raised blade points toward the upper corner, while pointed stones, small pebbles, and puddle-like outlines cover the ground around the warrior's feet.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters at City Docks Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands on the wooden planks of the City Docks in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing shoulder armor and small belt pouches. A crane with a dangling hook rises across the water, while a moored boat, rope-wrapped post, and tiered waterfront building fill the opposite side.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Stiix Coloring Page
pages.description: A warrior in goggles and a breathing mask appears in Stiix in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with ghostly figures drifting among crooked waterside buildings. Tubes curve around the helmet above layered chest armor, while wooden walkways, ladders, and a skull-topped arch add details to the background.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Frozen Wasteland Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja grips a long-handled pickaxe across the body in the Frozen Wasteland in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, surrounded by snow and ice. A mountain rises behind one shoulder, and pointed ice formations and cracks in the ground frame the warrior's chest badge and broad shoulder armor.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Skull Sorcerer Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: A warrior carries a large curved axe in the Skull Sorcerer Mine in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sword handle visible behind one shoulder. Skull motifs decorate the armor and cave wall, while crystal clusters and scattered rocks surround the full-length figure beneath hanging stalactites.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Fire Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja holds a sword diagonally across the chest inside the Fire Temple in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, facing forward with a focused expression. Two flaming wall torches flank the figure, and a large circular dragon emblem fills the upper portion of the stone temple background.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Digiverse Coloring Page
pages.description: A masked ninja wears circuit-patterned armor in the Digiverse in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a tall pointed crest rising from the helmet. Angular corridors, small control panels, and floating geometric shapes frame the close portrait, echoing the squares, lines, and hexagonal details on the chest.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Characters in Ninja Dojo Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: A ninja stands inside the Ninja Dojo Temple in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sheathed sword crossing behind the waist and both hands lowered. Wooden pillars and floorboards guide the view toward a gridded rear wall, while rows of curved roof tiles fill the upper edge.
